33 words for grief & longing

The 33 words below run from Abandoned to Yearning. Its core words are Lonely, Longing, Abandoned, Homesick, and Bereaved. Some are mild and some are intense, so start with the one that feels closest and read the words around it. If nothing fits, the families on either side of it on the wheel, Sadness and Joy & Energy, hold feelings that sit nearby.
